name: Eco-Nationalism
summary: Eco-nationalism joins nationalism with environmental politics: the nation and its citizens are held to have a special duty to protect their own land, species and landscapes, which become part of national identity and a ground for self-rule. It spans left and right, from civic versions (Scottish, Catalan, Baltic, Taiwanese, Norwegian) to the nativist 'patriotic ecology' of the French National Rally, so it agrees on nation, land and localism but splits on immigration, ethnicity, nuclear power and economics.
scope: The cross-strand core described by the scholarship (Jane Dawson, Conversi and Posocco, Bivar): environmental stewardship framed as a national task, including sub-state movements such as the Ogoni (MOSOP) and civic green-nation states, and nativist cases such as the RN. Where ethnic and civic strands disagree the profile gives 0 with a note; unaddressed statements are low-confidence inferences or 0. It excludes eco-fascist extremes and non-nationalist green politics.

sources.title: Which Nationalism for the Anthropocene? A Comparative Study of Exemplary Green Nation-States
sources.author: Daniele Conversi and Luca Posocco, Frontiers in Political Science
sources.usedFor: Green nationalism's stance on growth, taxes, localism, cities, democracy and cooperation.

sources.title: Ogoni Bill of Rights (foreword)
sources.author: Movement for the Survival of the Ogoni People
sources.usedFor: Claims of self-determination, control of resources, representation and protection of land and ecology.

universal-healthcare.rationale: The sources document no stance on health care; eco-nationalists range from left civic parties such as the SNP to the nativist right, so no common answer is inferable.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Wage policy is not part of the documented eco-nationalist core, and left and right strands would answer oppositely.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Conversi and Posocco blame infinite capital expansion for the Anthropocene and want environmental rules and taxes imposed on markets, so adherents distrust unregulated allocation.

public-ownership.rationale: Not addressed; civic left strands might favor it while right-wing strands would not, and the sources show no shared position.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Wealth taxation is not a documented eco-nationalist concern and the strands are split on economics.

unions-good.rationale: Labor unions are not discussed in the sources; the strands span left to right.

property-fundamental.rationale: Inferred from the idea that land and nature are a national trust to be protected by environmental rules, which implies property can be overridden for ecological ends.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Conversi favors environmental rules that bind firms, and the RN referendum proposal makes parent companies liable for their subsidiaries' ecological damage.

cut-welfare.rationale: Welfare is not discussed in the sources and the left and right strands split on it.

worker-ownership.rationale: No documented position; ownership structure is not a defining question for eco-nationalism.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Surveillance is not discussed; strands range from liberal democratic to the Chinese party-state.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Drug policy is outside the ideology's documented concerns.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: Not addressed; civic strands might favor limits and nativist strands oppose them.

strong-leader.rationale: Wikipedia notes both democratic cases (Taiwan, Scotland) and party-state cases (China), so adherents do not share a view on strong leaders.

state-harmful.rationale: Conversi and Posocco keep the nation-state as the basic unit of environmental action and Wikipedia describes eco-nationalism as state-legitimating, so abolishing the state is rejected.

limit-guns.rationale: Gun policy is not part of the documented ideology.

empower-police-military.rationale: The RN pairs ecology with national security, but other strands such as Ogoni or Baltic movements have no such stance, so this is split.

decide-locally.rationale: Bioregionalism and grassroots city action (Vauban, Buxtehude) favor local decisions, but national government remains the frame, so only a mild agreement is inferred.

rehabilitation.rationale: Criminal justice is not discussed in the sources.

traditional-family.rationale: Ethnic right-wing strands would agree and civic left strands would not; the sources record no shared position.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Strands span left to right and the sources document no stance.

abortion-legal.rationale: No documented position and the strands would split.

more-religion-public.rationale: Some strands draw on nature spirituality (Anastasianism, Sarna) but none argues for religion in public life as such.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Not addressed; civic left strands might agree while ethnic strands would not.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Not part of the documented ideology.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Eco-nationalism fuses environmentalism with national identity: Norway's friluftsliv, Wordsworth and the Group of Seven, and the RN's concern with national heritage all treat nature as part of national culture.

gradual-change.rationale: Change tempo is not documented; Ogoni and Baltic movements were insurgent while state versions are institutional.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Wikipedia records a split: ethnic eco-nationalists and the RN call open borders anti-ecological and favor restriction, while civic eco-nationalists are open and multicultural.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Le Pen says a globalist cannot be an environmentalist, while Conversi argues cosmopolitanism alone is insufficient; adherents lean toward national rather than supranational authority.

free-trade.rationale: The RN stresses short supply chains and local sourcing, and Conversi criticizes capital expansion and resource nationalism, so free trade is viewed skeptically.

nation-first.rationale: Eco-nationalism assigns the nation a special duty to its own environment and the RN's French-first stance links it to ecology, though Conversi stresses achievements that can be shared across borders.

open-borders.rationale: Le Pen calls open borders anti-ecological and ethnic eco-nationalists want closed borders; even civic strands keep national borders, so this is rejected.

limit-growth.rationale: Conversi blames infinite capital expansion, but China and Norway pursue green growth with continued oil drilling, so only a mild inference.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: The SNP and Catalan ERC declared climate emergencies and Wikipedia quotes a Hungarian nationalist saying no real nationalist is a climate denialist, though the RN favors different measures.

tech-solves-problems.rationale: Conversi cites green technology (electric vehicles, eco-labels) while romantic strands distrust industrial modernity; no shared view.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Documented split: Baltic, Taiwanese and German eco-nationalists built movements against nuclear plants, while the RN wants new reactors.

revolution-justified.rationale: Documented movements, such as the Ogoni and Taiwanese anti-nuclear protests, used protest and constitutional demands rather than revolution, so rejection is inferred.

experts-over-public.rationale: The RN framed its environmental referendum as taking ecology from the ideologues, and Norway's committee system gives citizens a role, so rule by experts is disfavored.

central-planning.rationale: Inferred from localism and market-based tools such as CO2 taxes; no source discusses central planning.

socialized-markets.rationale: Economic structure is not a shared eco-nationalist position.

tax-inheritance.rationale: Not addressed; strands diverge on economics.

basic-income.rationale: No source ties eco-nationalism to a basic income; left civic parties and nativist right parties would answer differently.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: RN localism and French-first nativism support protecting domestic production, though other strands do not discuss tariffs.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Conversi notes green subsidies and state-backed projects in Switzerland and Norway, but strands differ on state economic direction.

widespread-small-property.rationale: The RN rural localism favors farmers, but no source states a view on property distribution.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: Inferred: eco-nationalism works within the nation-state and market system with taxes and eco-labels, so abolishing money is far outside it.

abolish-central-banks.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from acceptance of state institutions and fiscal tools.

corporatist-bargaining.rationale: State-recognized wage bodies are not discussed in the eco-nationalist literature, and the strands do not share an economic-institution view.

one-party-rule.rationale: China's ecological civilization is a party-state case, but Taiwan, Baltic and Scottish cases arose from democratization, so the typical adherent does not endorse one-party rule.

monarchy-legitimate.rationale: The sources record no stance on monarchy; republics (Taiwan, Baltic states) and monarchies (Norway) both appear as green-nation cases.

democracy-best.rationale: Eco-nationalist protest was tied to democratization in Taiwan and the Eastern Bloc and Norway's model is participatory, though China is an exception.

direct-votes.rationale: The RN called for a referendum on the environment and Norway uses citizen committees, suggesting favor toward direct public input.

workers-councils.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from nation-state institutions as the frame.

right-to-secede.rationale: Ogoni claimed independence and political control of their affairs, Catalonia's ERC and the SNP combine nationalism with climate action, and Wikipedia links eco-nationalism to Soviet-era independence movements.

natural-rulers.rationale: Not documented; civic strands are democratic.

political-violence-never.rationale: The Ogoni movement was nonviolent but ethnic strands are not documented; no shared position.

war-builds-character.rationale: Conversi contrasts peaceful environmental nationalism with violent Volkisch and Nazi forms, implying war is not valued.

separate-church-state.rationale: Nature-spirituality movements appear (Anastasianism, Sarna) but no source states a church-state doctrine for the family.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: Nature spirituality appears but no strand grounds law in scripture.

private-courts-defense.rationale: Inferred from reliance on state institutions and national governments for environmental protection.

military-superiority.rationale: The RN stresses national security, but other strands do not address military policy.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Wikipedia documents the split between ethnic eco-nationalism (single ethnicity, nativist) and civic eco-nationalism (shared values), so adherents are genuinely divided.

class-struggle-history.rationale: Not a documented theme; nationalism rather than class is the organizing frame.

equal-outcomes.rationale: Distributional equality is not a documented concern of eco-nationalism and the strands span left and right.

indigenous-land-authority.rationale: The Ogoni claimed control over their land and ecology, but Wikipedia notes critics say eco-nationalism rarely engages indigenous knowledge.

colonial-reparations.rationale: Reparations are not discussed; critics note the ideology rarely engages indigenous or colonial history.

civilizational-union.rationale: The nation-state is the basic unit in the sources, so supranational civilizational union is not favored.

self-interest-moral.rationale: Environmental duty and national pride are framed as collective, so a self-interest ethic is disfavored.

duties-before-rights.rationale: Wikipedia says the nation-state and its citizens have a special duty to protect the country's environment, suggesting duty talk, though rights language is also used.

nature-intrinsic-value.rationale: Eco-nationalism treats nature as pristine and iconic, but this is as national heritage, so intrinsic value is only loosely implied.

limit-population.rationale: The RN is pronatalist for natives and others favor limits; no shared position.

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: Agro-romantic strands reject modernity, but mainstream cases such as Norway and Switzerland embrace modern industrial societies.

accelerate-technology.rationale: Conversi describes nature-loving nationalism coexisting with mechanization, but disruption of institutions is not a goal.

human-enhancement.rationale: Bodily enhancement is outside the topics eco-nationalist sources discuss; no inferable position.

algorithmic-government.rationale: Inferred from emphasis on citizen participation and populist distrust of technocrats.

unbreakable-encryption.rationale: Digital privacy is not part of the documented ideology and strands diverge between liberal and party-state cases.

restore-past-order.rationale: Agro-romantic and nativist strands look backward while civic green-state strands look forward.

results-over-ideology.rationale: Eco-nationalists are ideologically committed to nation and environment, but sources give no view on judging policy by results.

direct-action.rationale: Anti-nuclear protests (Wyhl, Chernobyl-era, Lungmen) and Ogoni mobilization were central to eco-nationalist movements.

means-match-ends.rationale: Methods-versus-ends reasoning is not discussed in the sources; protest and state action both occur.

return-to-foraging.rationale: Inferred: no eco-nationalist source proposes abandoning agriculture or the nation-state.

abolish-division-of-labor.rationale: Not documented; inferred from acceptance of national economies and trade within localism.

distribute-by-need.rationale: Not a documented position; inferred from the national, not communist, frame.

production-for-use.rationale: The RN promotes a circular economy and localism, but profit-versus-use is not a stated issue.

profit-exploitation.rationale: No source adopts a Marxist theory of profit.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: Inferred from the nationalist, non-Marxist character of the ideology.

collective-farming.rationale: RN localism supports individual farmers and compensation for carbon-sequestering farmers.

capitalism-causes-war.rationale: Conversi criticizes capital expansion but does not argue that capitalism causes war.

taxation-theft.rationale: Conversi cites Norway's high CO2 taxes as effective policy, so taxation for environmental ends is accepted.

harm-principle.rationale: Limits on liberty are not discussed in the sources, and strands range from liberal to party-state.

individual-rights-only.rationale: The Ogoni Bill of Rights claims rights as a people, including control of resources and self-determination, so group rights are central.

conscription.rationale: Military service is not discussed in the eco-nationalist sources; no shared position emerges.

exit-over-voice.rationale: Eco-nationalism emphasizes rootedness in land and a national home, which sits badly with exit as the main check.

state-as-business.rationale: The state is treated as a steward of the national environment, not a firm.

positive-liberty.rationale: The concept of freedom is not addressed in the documented sources.

media-academia-power.rationale: RN populism attacks establishment elites, but no source states this exact claim.

hereditarian-race.rationale: Bivar says the RN-linked Nouvelle Droite shifted from racial hierarchy to the language of diversity, and civic strands reject it.

organic-representation.rationale: Representation through families and trade bodies is not documented; Norwegian committees and referendums point other ways, so no clear answer.

total-state.rationale: China's party-state is an outlier; typical adherents want a state that protects the environment, not one directing all life.

national-rebirth.rationale: Not a documented theme in most strands.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Conversi contrasts peaceful green nationalism with expansionist forms; Ogoni and Baltic movements seek self-rule, not expansion.

bound-labor.rationale: Inferred; no strand advocates bound labor.

no-neutral-knowledge.rationale: Epistemology is not addressed; scientific climate claims are generally accepted but this does not settle the question.

universal-morality.rationale: Moral universalism is not discussed; Conversi's shared environmental pride across borders is too loose to infer an answer.

single-common-good.rationale: Sources do not address whether politics seeks one common good or balances interests.

diaspora-return-right.rationale: Return rights for diasporas are not discussed in the eco-nationalist sources.

revive-national-language.rationale: Cultural eco-nationalism and minority movements link language and landscape, though the sources do not discuss language revival directly.

workplace-democracy.rationale: Corporate governance is not documented as an eco-nationalist concern.

school-vouchers.rationale: Education finance is not discussed in the sources.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Fiscal stance is not documented; green-state cases such as Norway and Switzerland differ from populist right ones.

economic-freedom.rationale: Inferred from advocacy of environmental regulation and taxes.

rule-by-example.rationale: Rulers' moral example as a basis of government is not discussed; the sources centre on law and environmental policy.

national-self-determination.rationale: The Ogoni Bill of Rights claims political control over Ogoni affairs and independence as a people, and Wikipedia ties eco-nationalism to independence movements in the Baltics, Scotland and Catalonia.

force-without-un.rationale: Use of force abroad is not discussed in the sources, and strands cover pacific civic and security-minded nativist cases.

reason-over-faith.rationale: Nature spirituality appears in some strands but the question is not addressed.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: The RN national-priority principle applies, but civic strands would not restrict welfare; split.

work-for-welfare.rationale: Welfare conditionality is not discussed; left and right strands would split.

class-collaboration.rationale: Class relations are not a documented theme; the unit of analysis is the nation.

sacrifice-heritage.rationale: Heritage protection (Heimatschutz, Lebensreform) is part of nature-loving nationalism, and national heritage is central to eco-nationalist identity.

dominated-front.rationale: A common front of dominated countries is not documented, though Ogoni and Baltic cases involve resistance to larger states.

workers-nation.rationale: Eco-nationalism is nationally framed but sources never discuss working-class organization.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: Gender roles are not documented as an eco-nationalist topic; ethnic right and civic left would diverge.

ban-interest.rationale: Usury bans are not discussed in the eco-nationalist sources.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Even the nativist RN avoids hierarchy-of-races language and civic strands are multicultural, so legal racial segregation is not eco-nationalist.

state-class-instrument.rationale: The Marxist analysis is not documented; the state is treated as an environmental steward.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: The RN wants a moratorium on wind and solar but backs nuclear, and the Ogoni cause arose from oil pollution; mainstream strands oppose fossil expansion, though China and Norway show resource-nationalist exceptions.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Ethnic strands favor assimilation and civic strands accept multiculture; split.

elite-replacement.rationale: Bivar's RN account is nativist but does not state a replacement conspiracy; mainstream civic strands reject it.

proportional-representation.rationale: Electoral systems are not discussed in the sources; no stance can be inferred.

national-mission.rationale: Conversi describes pride in achievements shared across borders, not a mission to impose a form of government.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: Feminist analysis is not part of the documented ideology and strands would diverge.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: RN populism and Ogoni grievance against the federal government suggest distrust of elites.

heritable-defect-limits.rationale: Inferred; no source supports eugenics in eco-nationalism.

security-forces-accountable.rationale: Ogoni demands for protection and representation suggest accountability for state violence, though only inferred.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Eco-nationalism relies on state environmental regulation, taxes and subsidies, so a minimal state is rejected.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: Bivar shows the RN speaks of cultural, not racial, preservation; ethnic strands could differ.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Civic strands affirm equality; ethnic strands are not documented as denying moral worth.

socialism-one-country.rationale: A Marxist-Leninist debate with no documented link to eco-nationalism.

settler-state-colonial.rationale: The sources do not address settler colonialism, though critics say eco-nationalism extends colonial dichotomies of nature and culture.

uniform-civil-code.rationale: Personal-law uniformity is not discussed in the sources.

ban-cattle-slaughter.rationale: Cattle slaughter bans are not discussed; the RN criticizes factory farming but this is not the same question.

no-religion-state-schools.rationale: Religious instruction in state schools is not discussed in the sources.

state-strengthens-encirclement.rationale: A Marxist-Leninist doctrine about socialist states with no documented eco-nationalist counterpart.

consent-of-governed.rationale: Democratization-linked movements in Taiwan and the Eastern Bloc support consent-based legitimacy, though China is an exception.

trade-surplus.rationale: RN localism favors domestic production, but no source states an export-surplus goal.

population-transfer.rationale: Wikipedia describes ethnic strands as nativist but documents no expulsion program.

initiating-force-wrong.rationale: Libertarian non-aggression is not part of the documented ideology and strands would split.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: Conversi describes competition over environmental rankings as positive, but social Darwinist struggle is not documented.

ban-extremist-parties.rationale: Party bans are not discussed in the sources; no stance can be inferred.

freedom-as-non-domination.rationale: Republican freedom theory is not discussed in the eco-nationalist sources.

separated-powers.rationale: Norway's committees and city-national structure suggest institutional checks, but not explicit.

priority-to-poor.rationale: Priority to the poor is not documented as a position; the Ogoni case concerns a region, not the poor as a class.

right-to-buy-council-homes.rationale: A British housing policy question with no documented eco-nationalist position.

restrict-strikes-picketing.rationale: Strike law is not discussed in the sources.

population-causes-poverty.rationale: The Ogoni case locates poverty in resource extraction and political exclusion, not population.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: Ethnic strands and the RN hold that diversity is a threat, while civic strands are multicultural, so the documented position splits.

offices-by-lottery.rationale: Sortition appears nowhere in the sources, although Norway's citizen committees show some participatory leanings.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: Not documented; inferred from democratic-protest roots.

price-controls-essentials.rationale: Price controls are not discussed in the sources.

party-controls-media.rationale: China restricts environmental criticism, but this is an outlier among strands.

party-commands-army.rationale: Inferred from nationalist and not party-state frame.

long-naturalization-wait.rationale: Strands split on immigration, so no shared view.

representatives-worker-pay.rationale: Representatives' pay is not documented as a concern of the ideology.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: Party discipline is not discussed; strands include movements, parties and a party-state.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: The SNP and ERC tend to be pro-EU while the RN criticizes EU environmental rules; split.

head-commands-forces.rationale: Executive command of the military is not discussed in the sources.

church-by-bishops.rationale: Church governance is outside the topics the sources address.

censor-art-for-virtue.rationale: Cultural eco-nationalism celebrates art (Wordsworth, Group of Seven); censorship not documented.

unlimited-reelection.rationale: Inferred; democratic strands would limit terms.

recall-officials.rationale: Recall of officials is not discussed, though RN populism and citizen-participation cases might favor it.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Alliance policy is not documented; strands differ on international ties.

abolish-rental-housing.rationale: No source discusses housing tenure, and the answer is inferred as mild disagreement from a non-communal frame.

people-in-arms.rationale: An armed citizenry is not discussed in the sources.

rural-life-healthier.rationale: German agro-romanticism and RN land attachment value rural rootedness, though Conversi also praises green cities, so the view is mild.

reunify-divided-nation.rationale: Reunification of divided nations is not part of the documented eco-nationalist agenda.

educated-out-of-touch.rationale: Bivar says RN voters see themselves as left behind by the white-collar professional elite and the patriot ecology answers that grievance.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: Civic strands agree, ethnic strands do not; split.

death-penalty.rationale: Capital punishment is not addressed and strands span liberal and authoritarian cases.

sex-ed-in-schools.rationale: Sex education is not discussed in the sources.

creationism-in-schools.rationale: Not documented; inferred from environmental science orientation.

restrict-pornography.rationale: Pornography is not an eco-nationalist topic in the sources.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: Ethnic strands favor descent while civic strands favor territory.

minority-language-support.rationale: Civic and minority strands would agree and nativist strands would not.

religious-exemptions.rationale: Religious exemptions from law are not discussed.

encourage-eccentricity.rationale: Social conformity versus eccentricity is not documented as a theme.

sovereign-debt-cancellation.rationale: Sovereign debt is not discussed in the sources.

independence-needs-economic-change.rationale: The Ogoni bill ties political self-determination to control of economic resources, though not a full property transformation.

constituent-assembly.rationale: Constitutional drafting procedure is not addressed.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: China's resource nationalism put growth first, but green strands reject that tradeoff.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: Foreign aid duties are not documented; Conversi's shared-border pride is too loose to infer a stance.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.rationale: Nuclear weapons policy is not discussed, though anti-nuclear movements existed against nuclear power, not weapons.

direct-election-head-of-state.rationale: Head-of-state selection is not discussed in the sources.

central-bank-independence.rationale: Monetary governance is not documented as a concern.

no-land-for-peace.rationale: Territorial compromise is not addressed in the sources.

property-serves-common-good.rationale: The Ogoni claim resources for community development and Conversi supports regulation for environment, implying property serves collective ends.

soviet-state-capitalist.rationale: A Marxist debate with no documented eco-nationalist position.

precautionary-principle.rationale: Environmental protection is the core aim and eco-nationalist governments (SNP, ERC) legislated emergency measures; precaution is implied but not named.

collective-defense.rationale: Alliance mutual defense is not discussed in the sources.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: Baltic and Soviet-era independence movements treated annexation as illegitimate, though only loosely tied to the statement.

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: Church-state power balance is not discussed.

nonpartisan-head-of-state.rationale: Role of the head of state is not discussed in the sources.

force-to-prevent-secession.rationale: Sub-state eco-nationalists (Catalonia, Scotland) oppose forced union while state versions (China) differ.

region-keeps-system.rationale: One-country-two-systems arrangements are not discussed; sub-state autonomy demands exist but not this model.

flat-income-tax.rationale: Conversi endorses environmental taxes, which imply active tax design; not discussed directly.

character-from-environment.rationale: Nature versus nurture is not addressed; Wikipedia only notes nature is treated as outside culture.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: Inferred from democratic and constitutional strands.

space-expansion.rationale: Inferred; focus is on protecting a national environment.

mixed-constitution.rationale: Classical mixed-constitution theory is not discussed.

equal-parenting.rationale: Family-court custody presumptions are not documented as an eco-nationalist topic.

class-struggle-under-socialism.rationale: A Maoist doctrine with no documented eco-nationalist counterpart.

land-redistribution.rationale: Agrarian land reform is not discussed; the Ogoni claim over land is communal not redistributive.

refugee-return.rationale: Refugee return is not discussed in the sources.

co-ethnic-territorial-claim.rationale: Conversi contrasts peaceful green nationalism with irredentist ethnic forms.

apostasy-punishable.rationale: Inferred; none of the documented strands endorse it.

women-must-cover.rationale: Inferred; none of the documented strands endorse it.

kin-peoples-union.rationale: Nation-state is basic unit in sources; supranational ethnic union not documented.

national-cultural-autonomy.rationale: Ogoni sought autonomy within Nigeria for their own affairs and Baltic minority environmentalism is described as green citizenship, though not exactly this model.

rights-where-you-live.rationale: Whether persecuted minorities should emigrate or fight for rights is not discussed, though the Ogoni fought within Nigeria.

material-conditions-drive-history.rationale: Historical materialism is not part of the documented ideology.

ban-cartels.rationale: Conversi's critique of unlimited capital expansion implies sympathy for curbing concentration, though not stated.

no-bailouts.rationale: Bailout policy is not discussed in the sources.

courts-bound-by-majority.rationale: Spain's Supreme Court vetoed Catalonia's climate law, which sub-state nationalists oppose, but RN populists differ; split.

gender-parity-bodies.rationale: Gender quotas are not documented as an eco-nationalist topic.

economic-self-sufficiency.rationale: RN localism favors domestic production but not a closed bloc, and civic strands trade.

trade-labor-env-standards.rationale: Conversi stresses shared environmental achievement and competition over rankings, suggesting acceptance of binding environmental standards.

moral-incentives.rationale: Moral versus material incentives is not discussed; Conversi's tax-based tools favor material incentives, but this does not settle it.

armed-group-creates-revolution.rationale: The Ogoni movement was a nonviolent mass movement and no source supports armed vanguardism.

abolish-hereditary-privilege.rationale: Aristocratic privilege is not discussed in the sources.

history-own-civilization.rationale: Cultural eco-nationalism teaches national landscapes and heritage as identity.

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: Wikipedia notes critics tie eco-nationalism to colonial dichotomies, but adherents do not endorse tutelage.

patriotic-education.rationale: Taiwan's cycling ritual is framed as patriotism and eco-nationalism treats environmental pride as national identity.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: Affirmative action is not documented as a topic; strands would divide.

public-money-creation.rationale: Money creation is not discussed in the sources.

capitalism-adapts.rationale: Crisis theory of capitalism is not addressed.

former-empire-influence.rationale: Not documented; inferred from non-expansionist frame.

delink-world-market.rationale: Conversi praises global environmental rankings and RN localism does not call for delinking.

labor-aristocracy.rationale: A Marxist-Leninist thesis with no documented eco-nationalist position.

freedom-to-discriminate.rationale: Not documented; inferred from environmental regulation orientation.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: Constitutional rights entrenchment is not discussed in the sources.

colonial-treaties-void.rationale: Not discussed, although Ogoni and other minority claims concern imposed borders.

elective-rulers.rationale: Method of choosing rulers is not discussed apart from general democratic leanings.

resist-lawless-ruler.rationale: The sources do not address a right of resistance to rulers who break the law.

parliament-supreme.rationale: Parliamentary versus monarchical supremacy is not discussed.

animal-suffering-matters.rationale: The RN criticizes factory farms, suggesting concern for animal welfare, though not framed as sentience.

animal-use-humane.rationale: RN criticism of factory farms and support for local farming suggests acceptance of animal use with humane limits.

noblesse-oblige.rationale: Duties of the privileged are not discussed in the sources.

withdraw-from-politics.rationale: Inferred; eco-nationalist movements are explicitly political.

mass-culture-pacifies.rationale: Critical theory of mass culture is not part of the documented ideology.

ruling-class-consent.rationale: Gramscian hegemony is not a documented eco-nationalist idea.

native-born-offices.rationale: Nativist RN strands might favor this but civic strands would not, and the sources do not state it.

party-own-road.rationale: An intra-communist question with no eco-nationalist counterpart.

self-reliance-over-aid.rationale: RN localism favors self-reliance but the statement concerns poor countries.

return-lost-territory.rationale: Irredentist demands are not documented in the sources, so no position can be assigned.

indigenous-political-leadership.rationale: The Ogoni sought self-rule within Nigeria, but political leadership of indigenous descendants over settlers is not discussed.

antifascism-founding-value.rationale: Not discussed; civic strands and nativist strands would answer differently.

totalitarianisms-equivalent.rationale: Not discussed in the sources; strands differ in their relation to the right and left.

slavery-not-civil-war-cause.rationale: An American historical dispute with no connection to eco-nationalism in the sources.

preserve-contested-monuments.rationale: Monument controversies are not discussed; heritage values suggest some sympathy but sources are silent.

institutions-fit-civilization.rationale: China invokes traditional ecological wisdom as an authentic alternative to Western liberal democracy.

filial-duty.rationale: Family obligations are not discussed in the sources.

foreign-takeover-block.rationale: RN sovereigntist localism favors protecting national assets.

recallable-delegates.rationale: Imperative mandates are not discussed, though RN populism and participatory cases suggest sympathy.

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: Pension design is not discussed in the sources.

land-use-tenure.rationale: Use-based land tenure is not discussed; Ogoni claims are communal but not framed this way.

budget-needs-parliament.rationale: Democratic strands support parliamentary control; weakly inferred.

single-official-language.rationale: Language policy is not stated, and Baltic minority and nativist strands would differ.

foreign-land-ownership.rationale: Bivar describes RN sovereignty over native lands as the route to protecting them from outsiders.

consumerism-harmful.rationale: Conversi blames infinite expansion and the RN promotes localism and a circular economy, which imply critique of consumerism.

arm-foreign-insurgents.rationale: Covert support for foreign insurgents is not documented; the inference is mild disagreement from the peaceful, self-determination emphasis of the documented strands.

intervene-in-bloc.rationale: Not documented; inferred as disagreement from the emphasis on national self-determination.

corporate-influence.rationale: RN populism and RN proposal on parent company liability suggest concern with corporate power.

restrict-foreign-funding.rationale: Sovereigntist nativism favors restricting outside influence.

pronatalist-incentives.rationale: Not documented in the sources; strands split.

residents-only-property.rationale: Bivar presents local sovereignty over native lands as central to RN ecology.

job-guarantee.rationale: Employment policy is not discussed in the sources.

democratic-peace.rationale: Democratic peace theory is not discussed, though Conversi links green nationalism with peaceful competition.

no-duty-to-obey.rationale: Not documented; inferred as mild disagreement from the movements' respect for national legal order.

minority-conspiracy.rationale: Not documented; Bivar's account stresses cultural not conspiratorial rhetoric.

abolish-legal-marriage.rationale: Not documented; inferred as mild disagreement because traditional institutions are generally respected in nationalist strands.

public-access-to-information.rationale: Norway's committee model and civic participation suggest openness.

local-production.rationale: The RN calls localism and short supply chains the ecological alternative to globalism and Conversi highlights local grassroots action.

informal-organisation.rationale: Inferred; movements organize as parties and national institutions.

national-law-over-international.rationale: Bivar and RN sovereignty stance prioritize national law, but not explicitly addressed for all strands.

religious-nation.rationale: Not documented; the ethnic and civic strands in Wikipedia define the nation by ethnicity or values, not religion.

regional-revenue-retention.rationale: The Ogoni claim control of Ogoni resources for Ogoni development and Wikipedia notes Westminster, Nigerian redistribution grievances.

personal-possessions-private.rationale: Communist property theory is not discussed in the sources.

defeat-communism.rationale: Anti-communism is not documented as part of the ideology; Soviet-era eco-nationalists opposed the Soviet state, but this does not establish a general position.

mixed-public-service-providers.rationale: Public service delivery models are not discussed.

religion-illusion.rationale: Nature spirituality appears in some strands (Anastasianism, Sarna).

capitalism-progressive.rationale: Not discussed; Conversi's critique of expansion is partly offset by green profit alignment, so no clear stance.

purge-loanwords.rationale: Linguistic purism is not documented, though cultural eco-nationalism values language in national identity.

treaties-binding.rationale: Treaty rights of nations within a state are not discussed beyond Ogoni demands.

cooperative-communities.rationale: Intentional communities appear in Switzerland's Monte Verita and Vauban examples, but not as a program of the ideology.

majority-settlement.rationale: Not documented; inferred as mild disagreement because settlement of minorities' regions conflicts with civic and sub-state self-determination.

historical-land-claim.rationale: Eco-nationalism roots nation in its landscape.

holocaust-denial.rationale: Bivar notes Marine Le Pen distanced the party from her father's Holocaust denial.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Not documented; inferred as mild disagreement given civic and sub-state strands with liberal norms.

punish-blasphemy.rationale: Not documented; inferred as mild disagreement because the strands are secular or nature-spiritual rather than confessional.

colonies-serve-metropole.rationale: The Ogoni case is a protest against extraction for the benefit of a distant centre.

defensive-jihad-duty.rationale: Islamic jurisprudence is not part of the documented ideology; mild disagreement inferred.

unreligious-rulers-fought.rationale: Not documented; inferred from the absence of any theocratic strain in the sources.

intersecting-oppressions.rationale: Intersectionality is not discussed in the sources.

left-right-obsolete.rationale: Wikipedia says adherents span the left-right spectrum but share nation-and-environment focus.

alienated-labor.rationale: Marxist labor theory is not part of the documented ideology.

divine-source-of-authority.rationale: Not documented; inferred from the democratic and nationalist frame of the sources.

social-market-economy.rationale: Not discussed; strands from Norway to the RN vary widely on economic model.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Not documented; inferred as strong disagreement because the strands treat the nation-state as the unit and the RN stresses national security.

rich-first.rationale: Not documented; inferred as mild disagreement from environmental and collective duty frames.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: Bloc policy is not discussed in the sources.

dynastic-succession.rationale: Not documented; inferred as mild disagreement given democratic and republican cases in the sources.

interest-free-mutual-credit.rationale: Mutual credit systems are not discussed in the sources.

property-franchise.rationale: Not documented; inferred as strong disagreement from the democratic character of the movements.

domination-women-nature.rationale: Ecofeminism is not documented as part of eco-nationalism.

reification.rationale: Marxist-Lukacsian theory is not part of the documented ideology.

racial-franchise.rationale: Not documented; RN and civic strands reject racial hierarchy language.

online-participation.rationale: Not discussed beyond the general participatory emphasis.

interfaith-marriage-restriction.rationale: Not documented; inferred as mild disagreement.

boycott-minority-shops.rationale: Not documented; inferred as strong disagreement because the RN presents its stance as cultural not exclusionary and civic strands reject it.

state-promotes-atheism.rationale: Not documented; inferred as strong disagreement because nature spirituality appears in several strands and no strand favors state atheism.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: Not documented; inferred as strong disagreement from the state-centered approach.

vote-delegation.rationale: Liquid democracy is not discussed in the sources.

existential-risk-priority.rationale: Not discussed, though climate-focused strands treat environmental risk seriously.

abolish-ip.rationale: Not documented; inferred as mild disagreement given reliance on existing market institutions.

uniformed-youth.rationale: Not documented; inferred as mild disagreement given the civic and democratic strands.

no-nuclear-weapons-on-territory.rationale: Not addressed directly though anti-nuclear activism existed.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: Not documented; inferred as mild disagreement given the national-defense emphasis of nationalism.

unbroken-national-continuity.rationale: Not discussed in the sources; ethnic strands may accept it and civic strands would not.

culture-before-state.rationale: Not discussed; Ogoni and state-building cases would differ.

economy-in-majority-hands.rationale: Ogoni want Ogoni control, but statement concerns majority groups.

socialism-needs-workers-power.rationale: A Marxist definition of socialism with no eco-nationalist counterpart.

local-essentials-public.rationale: Inferred from localism and green city initiatives.

municipal-property.rationale: Not discussed; bioregionalism and localism are related but sources state no property model.

confederal-coordination.rationale: Not discussed; libertarian municipalist model not documented in the sources.

person-over-state.rationale: Not discussed; Ogoni stress group rights but this does not settle the individual-versus-state question.

spiritual-nature.rationale: Anastasianism, Sarna and harmony between humanity and nature.

regional-powers-revocable.rationale: Spain's Supreme Court vetoed Catalonia's climate law and sub-state eco-nationalists oppose revocable autonomy.

gm-crops.rationale: German far-right publications discussed genetically modified food critically, and RN opposes GMOs, but not a documented unified position.

dense-cities.rationale: Conversi praises car-free Vauban and Oslo but agro-romantic strands favor countryside.

racial-group-interests.rationale: RN language emphasizes cultural not racial interests.

racial-pride.rationale: Not discussed; ethnic strands may agree while civic strands would not.

language-defines-nation.rationale: Not discussed in the sources; ethnic and civic strands define nations differently.

communal-electorates.rationale: Not documented; inferred as mild disagreement from the national-citizenship frame.

pollution-taxes.rationale: Conversi cites Norway's high CO2 taxes as effective environmental policy.

future-generations.rationale: Eco-nationalism assigns the nation duties to protect its environment, which implies intergenerational stewardship.

soldiers-refuse-war.rationale: Not documented; inferred as mild disagreement given nationalism and Conversi's peaceful but not pacifist model.

restructure-world-economy.rationale: Not discussed; Ogoni and RN would answer differently.

nature-as-capital.rationale: Conversi cites environmental rules aligned with profit and Wikipedia notes ecotourism benefits.

sacred-nation.rationale: Not discussed, though cultural eco-nationalism treats landscapes as national icons.

internal-colonialism.rationale: Ogoni and Scottish cases frame the center as extracting resources or dumping waste on a region.

religions-one-truth.rationale: Not addressed; strands range from secular to religious, and no position can be inferred.

farm-price-support.rationale: Inferred from its localism and support for protecting national land and rural livelihoods, as in the RN's ecology of local production.

keep-nuclear-weapons.rationale: Inferred from nationalist emphasis on national security and self-rule; strands are not unanimous.

workers-own-party.rationale: Inferred from its national framing, which sets the nation above class parties.

ban-fgm.rationale: Not addressed by the sources; inferred from civic nationalist strands, while nativist ones may not stress it.

women-property-inheritance.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from civic strands, though customary-land claims such as the Ogoni's complicate it.

one-language-many-names.rationale: Language politics split the strands: sub-state nationalists defend distinct language names while others stress one national language.

pollution-tort-liability.rationale: Inferred from the Ogoni and green-nation cases, which favour state or national control of resources and regulation over private suits.

customary-chiefs-lawmaking.rationale: Inferred as split: Ogoni-style movements stress traditional rule while civic green-nation states use elected bodies.

environment-over-liberty.rationale: Its strands treat protecting the national land and species as a duty that can limit individual freedoms.

mandatory-sentences.rationale: Not addressed; strands differ and no position can be inferred.

immigrants-learn-language.rationale: Nationalist strands, notably the RN, stress language and integration as a condition of belonging to the nation.

missingStatements.text: A nation has a special duty to protect its own land, wildlife and landscapes.
missingStatements.rationale: Wikipedia's definition of eco-nationalism rests on this duty, and no existing statement captures it.
missingStatements.declined: Defining claim of eco-nationalism only; no other ideology would take a clear side, and adding it would force every future audit to answer a statement that does not discriminate. Partly covered by preserve-national-culture and nature-intrinsic-value.

missingStatements.text: A community should be able to protect its land and ecology from damage by outside developers or companies.
missingStatements.rationale: The Ogoni Bill of Rights asserts the right to protect Ogoni land and ecology from further degradation.
missingStatements.declined: Covered by existing statements on local decision-making and indigenous authority over land (decide-locally, indigenous-land-authority); too close to them to earn its own statement.

missingStatements.text: Preserving the cultural distinctiveness of each people is comparable to protecting biodiversity.
missingStatements.rationale: RN strategist Hervé Juvin applies the logic of species diversity to human cultural diversity.

notes: Immigration, ethnicity and nuclear power split the family. The RN backs nuclear and opposes wind, while Baltic, Taiwanese and German movements opposed nuclear. Eco-fascism is not represented.
